Ale przechodząc do konkretów: Mamy tu do czynienia z bardzo dobrą grą superbohaterską, która przerywa hegemonię Batmanowej serii Arkham. Spider-Man to gratka dla miłośników Petera Parkera. Nie brakuje tu bijatyk, desperackich prób łączenia życia osobistego z życiem superbohatera oraz wykonywania zadań bazujących na pomocy przeciętnym obywatelom (jak na miłego pająka z sąsiedztwa przystało). Tym co doskonale spaja wszystkie zadania jest wyśmienity system przemieszczania się po mieście. Animacje bujania sięzachwycają, a całość jest zwyczajnie satysfakcjonująca, jeśli dodać do tego niezłą fabułe mamy produkt niemal idealny.  Jednak nie mogę powiedzieć, że gra jest nieskazitelna, zdarzają się tu dziwne błędy (ciężarówki wyjeżdżające ze ściany lub postacie mówiące po polsku w angielskiej wersji gry i vice versa), zadania poboczne są mocno nijakie i bardzo odstają od głównego wątku, a aktywności w Nowym Jorku są mocno schematyczne. Czarę goryczy przelewa (w mojej opinii) mocno chaotyczny system walki, któremu daleko do batmanowego obijania pysków. Strasznie sprzeczny z realiami gry jest fakt, że za dużo tu broni palnej i wybuchowej, której przeciwnicy używają nawet w centrum miasta (co regularnie kończyłoby się ofiarami ze strony cywilnej). Nie pisałbym o tym, gdyby nie fakt że w grze są osiągnięcia i wyzwania bazujące na owym systemie. Słowem końca przygody człowieka-pająka to naprawdę wartościowa produkcja, która w mojej ocenie mogłaby kosztować trochę mniej, zdecydowanie warto poczekać na jakąś promocje.

21.5 Saat ile inceleme yazmak yeterli bir süre midir orası tartışılır ama oyuna basit bir şekilde ''DARK SOULS 4'' diyebiliriz.  Oyundaki Lore'u uzun uzun anlatmaya gerek yok. Kısacası yine ortada doymak bilmeyen, güç gösterisi yapan Tanrı diye adlandırılan Bosslarımız var. Onların yaratmış olduğu kaosa biz Elden Ring Lord'u olma göreviyle son vermeye çalışıyoruz.  Oyun oynanış bakımından kesinlikle Dark Souls III ayarında diyebiliriz. Şimdi bazı Dark Souls haterları ''Abi yapma ya oyunun Dark Souls ile alakası yok'' demek isteseler de oyun tam olarak Dark Souls 4 arkadaşlar xD  Ama Dark Souls 4 demek, Dark Souls III'teki eksikliklerin vs düzeltilmiş, grafikleri yeniden baştan yaratılmış, üstüne 150 nin üzerinde Boss eklenmiş halidir(Ki Area Boss'ları o kadar tırt Bosslar değil, Dark Souls III'teki Champion Gundyr ile kapışırlar). Ayrıca bu kadarla kalmayıp üzerine bir de Açık Dünya patlatmışlar ki bu özellik bile başlı başına oyunu direkt göklere çıkarıyor. Oyundaki yenilikleri aşağıda maddeler halinde tek tek açıklayacağım.  -Öncelikle Class'lar kısmından başlayalım. Oyundaki Class'lar yine tipik souls-like class'ları gibi Dex için, Str için, Int için ayrı statları olan Class'lar dır. Bu bir Guide olmadığı için tek tek açıklamıyorum, bu konu hakkında Elden Ring Wiki'den çok daha detaylı bilgi alabilirsiniz.   -''Oyunu daha 20 saat oynamışsın, neyin tecrübesini aktarıyorsun?'' Diyenler için : Arkadaşlar, Souls-Like oyunlarının şöyle bir özelliği vardır, belki bilmiyorsunuzdur. Eğer bir Souls-Like oyununun, ilk 3-5-10 saatinden sıkılmadıysanız, emin olun oyun ilerledikçe alacağınız zevk katlanacaktır. Dark Souls 2, seri arasında genelde en sevilmeyen oyundur. Ben Dark Souls 2 yi ilk oynadığımda, daha ilk dakikalarda sürü psikolojisine kapıldım ve oyun harbi kötüymüş dedim direkt. Fakat benim daha önce oyunu bitirmiş olan arkadaşım, ''sadece biraz daha şans ver oyuna, ilk başları biraz sıkıcıdır'' dedi ve bi 10-15 saat daha oynadım. Oynadıkça oyunun açıldığını ve gerçekten zevk aldığımı farkettim. Şimdi konumuza dönelim..  -Oyundaki en ama en önemli olan ve oyuna ''Eee bitirdik oyunu 70 saat sürdü ne olcak şimdi'' olayının yaşanmaması için oyuna devamlılık sağlayan bir diğer şey ise silah ve büyü çeşitliliğidir. O kadar çok çeşitli büyü tipleri var ki, oyunu bitirseniz bile o büyüleri denemeden oyunu bırakmak istemeyeceksiniz. Eğer ilk defa Souls-Like'a adım atıyorsanız dikkat, bu oyun+seri aşırı bağımlılık yapar arkadaşlar. Witcher gibi oynadım bitti mantığı yoktur. Bilginize..  -Oyunda çok çeşitli silahlar vardır ve hemen hemen her silahın kendine özel Weapon Art'ı vardır. Gökyüzünden yıldırım çekip fırlatan mı dersin, yerde kraterler açıp adama Void gönderen mi dersin aklınıza gelemiyecek o kadar özel Weapon Art' ı olan silah var ki... Bu bile Hype için yeter.  -Evet, uzak doğu hayranı arkadaşlar.. Oyunda Mortal Blade'de var...(Rivers of Blood)  -Oyundaki büyüler genel başlık altında ikiye ayrılmıştır, ''Sorceries'' (Bildiğimiz INT büyüleri) ve ''Incantations'' (Daha çok Faith ve bu oyunda yeni gördüğümüz stat olan Arcane stat'ı ile güçlenen ve havuzu çok geniş olan bir büyü başlığıdır).   -Evet arkadaşlar üşenmedim saydım, oyunda 70 adet ''Sorceries'' büyüleri, 101 adet de ''Incantations'' büyüleri vardır. Neden bu büyü konusu üzerinde bu kadar durduğumu düşünüp ''Abicim sen oyunu anlat, bize ne büyüden, oyun iyi mi, değil mi?'' diye soracak olanlara hemen şu cevabı vermek istiyorum. Arkadaşlar oyunu kılıç kalkanla bir yere kadar oynayacaksınız, adamlar oyuna yaklaşık 200 adet büyü eklemiş ki bu büyüler önceki oyunlarda gördüğümüz şimşek al at, asa'dan mavi ışık at büyüleri değiller. O kadar yaratıcı, görseli acayip güzel olan büyüler var ki emin olun herkesin hoşuna gidecektir.   -Önceki Souls-Like oyunlarındaki gibi ''Eee hocam ben şimdi nereye gidicem?'' sorusuna da bir çözüm bulup, minimap getirmişler ve oyuncuyu açık dünyada sıkmamak için minimap üzerindeki açmış olduğunuz Bonfire'lara teleport yapma özelliğini de oyuna katmışlar. Bu gerçekten çok güzel bir özellik çünkü minimapte iki adım gözüken yer oyun içinde dağ tepe derken on dakikaya çıkabiliyor ve bir Bonfire bulduğunuz zaman sıradaki Bonfire'ın yönünü (Yani ne tarafa gitmem gerek sorusunun cevabını) göstermektedir.(Tabiki nokta atışı şeklinde göstermiyor, bir santimetrelik bir ok ile yön gösteriyor sadece. Bu da eski Dark Souls oyunlarındaki, oyuncuların nereye gideğini bilmeyip oyundan sıkılmasının önüne geçmiş oluyor.   -Daha çok anlatılacak şey var ama anlatıp öğrenmektense oynayıp öğrenmenizi tercih ederim. Oyunun nasıl olduğuna gelecek olursak, arkadaşlar oyun Souls-Like severler için biçilmiş kaftan. Daha önce hiç oynamamış kişiler için ise güzel bir başlangıç paketi. Sistem özelliklerim 1050ti I5 7400 olmasına rağmen 40+ FPS ile dropsuz oynamaktayım. Oyun ilk yayınlandığındaki o drop sorunları vs tamamen ortadan kalktı.   -Evet Türkiye şartlarında oyun pahalı, malesef ilk oyun yayınlandığında 299tl olarak yayınlandı ve Pre-Order yapmanın mantıksız olacağını düşünerekten yapmadım. Fakat sonra kur dalgalanmaları sebebiyle 499tl ye yükseldi ve güzel bir sövüş gerçekleştirdik. Ama bu kalitede, bu grafikte bir oyun için, hadi ama arkadaşlar dürüst olalım, 499tl emin olun az bile. Crack oyuna karşıyım, hayatımda her fiyattan oyun aldım ama bir oyun için verdiğim en iyi 499tl diyebilirim net bir şekilde. Oyunu kesinlikle almalısınız, çünkü her ne kadar Fan-Boy yorumu olarak gözükse de gerçekten oyunu beğenmemek / olumsuz eleştirmek için bir sebebiniz yok xD

„Oh shit, I just shit my pants“ - Leonardo da Vinci, presumably, after being stalked by Michael Myers.  Now, I gotta say: I really do have a Love/Hate-Relationship with this game. In the game four survivors are hunted by one homicidal maniac, who is trying to stab or slash them with a blunt or sharp object. For people living in Texas or in the German town Wuppertal this is nothing new, however, if you don‘t, this game delivers an experience no other game can deliver.  I like both, playing killer and survivor therefore I can say the game can potentially be great fun. Some rounds though, feel like having sex for the first time. They are short, frustrating and the end result is rather disappointing.   Playing with friends on the other hand is mostly fun: „Survive with friends“ means that  you are trying to survive together against one random killer, where you will mostly just fake trying to help your companions, while in reality you are searching the hatch to be able to escape alone after their demise.  In „Kill your Friends“ you will have the opportunity to play the killer yourself. This is great for telling you friends that „it’s just the games mechanics“ so you don’t have to admit that you are a sadistic asshole.  Having said all this this game really is worth it most of the time, while some moments will be frustrating (but as you might already know this is true for most games). If you are not sure if this is for you, get it in a sale and definitely play it with friends.  „Damn, I hate those loopers“ - maybe Oscar Wilde, while chasing Meg Thomas for 5 minutes straight.

Parasının daha fazlasını sonuna kadar hak eden ve gerçek anlamda oyuncuya kıymet veren bir oyun. Bakın burası çok önemli. Oyun belli yerlerde elinizden tutuyor, ufak ipuçları veriyor. Onun dışında gerçek bir açık dünya deneyimi veriyor size. İstediğiniz şekilde hatalar ve doğrular yapıyorsunuz. Yolunuzu çiziyorsunuz.   Saçma sapan şuraya git bunu yap olayı yok. Gerçekten çok çok eşsiz bir deneyim sunuyor Elden Ring. Tabii ki souls esintileri var. Dövüşte olsun, bazı mekaniklerde olsun ama kesinlikle aynı oyun değil. Tüm souls serisinin suyunu sıkmış birisi olarak gerçekten farklı hissettiriyor ve farklı bir oyun olduğunu görüyorsunuz.   100 saati geçtim ve hala oyunu bitirmedim. Her yere gidiyorum her şeyi alıyorum ve her yere adım atmaya çalışıyorum. Bu geçirdiğim sürede oyun asla sıkmadı. Açık dünya oyunlarının genel sorunu kendini tekrarlama hissi var mı derseniz, evet biraz var ama sadece biraz. O da çok az şeyde kendini belli ediyor. Ufak zindanlar vs. Onun dışında oyun size o duyguyu yaşatmıyor. Yaşayacağım dediğiniz anda yaşamıyorsunuz, yani çok nadir yerlerde.   Oyunun dünyası gerçekten çok katmanlı. Yani ben böyle bir oyun görmedim. Bir bölgeye gidiyorsunuz girişi var, üstü var, üstünün üstü var, altı var, altının altı var. Her yer için geçerli değil tabii ki tadını çok güzel tutmuşlar böyle şeylerin.  Çeşitlilik çok fazla. Temel seçimler sonrası (savaşçı, büyücü vs.) Bunları kendi içerisinde bir sürü parçaya bölebiliyorsunuz. Bunun dışında mekanlar, atmosfer, düşmanlar, eşyalar vs. bol bol çeşit var. Sadece bazı düşmanlardan bir çok yerde değiştirilmiş halini görüyoruz. Basit değiştirmeler değil tabii ki ama böyle şeyler genel olarak kaçınılmazdır. Çünkü büyük ve katmanlı bir haritası var her noktaya tamamen farklı şeyleri hiç bir oyun koyamaz. Yinede her yerde farklılıkları görüyoruz.  Kozmetik olarak görünüşler muhteşem. Açık dünya manzaraları gerçekten çok ama çok iyi. Zaten o gideceğiniz yerleri görme olayı insanı çok etkiliyor. Kaplama kalitesini en iyi yapan oyun mu? Hayır değil fakat size görsel şölen yapması için bunun bir engel olmadığını kesinlikle gösteriyor. Sanat tasarımcılarını gerçekten tebrik etmek gerek. Özellikle bu alanda rakipsiz.  Eksi yönleri illaki var. özellikle ilk çıktığında ama çok iyi bir oyun olduğunu değiştirmez. Benim en çok gözüme batan yerleri şu iki nokta oldu. 1. Düşmanları öldürdüğümüzde kazandığımız rünlerin çok dengesiz oluşu. Hareket bile edemeyen düşmanlar 3-4k verirken, sizi yerden yere vuran elemanlar 4-5k veriyor. Zaten farm yapılan yerler var ama çoğu kişi farm yapmayı tercih etmiyor. 2. olarak beni en çok üzen kısım pvp oldu. DS3 oynayanlar bilir PVP kısmı çok güzeldi çok zevkliydi. Burada aynısını diyemeyeceğim. Gelmek bir garip gitmek bir garip. Özellikle PVP de savaşırken gerçekten adama vurmak çok zor. İçinden geçiyor değmiyor. Bir yerinden geçiyor değmiyor. Artık sunuculara olan uzaklığımızdan mı kaynaklı başka şeyden mi bilmiyorum. DS serisinde de bu durum vardı ama bu kadar değildi. Yine de oyuna bi zevk atıyor. Hiç oynanmaz değil ama olmamış bence. But in it's current state I can't recommend it to anyone who I don't 100% know will enjoy it.  It has a steep learning curve, mechanics that aren't explained well(or at all) in game, or on the Wiki, and a tutorial that goes over the barest bones of the game experience, without really tutorializing anything aside from the bare basics of game play.    The game wants you to learn from what went wrong, and get into a rhythm of what to do... And some people might actually do that.  The rest will go streaming to the wiki, or to reddit, or to youtube videos, looking for help, advice, and tips for things the game hasn't actually taught them.... and that's not the best first impression for someone diving into a new game.  As I said, I love this game, I'm not going anywhere.. But I can't in good conscience recommend this game to anyone at the current moment.

Don't read these butthurt negative reviews. All these complaints are THINGS THAT CAN BE PATCHED and do not listen to the Gamespot (or all these other casual pleb pandering sites like IGN or PC gamer) review complaining that the death animations are too long as well as the combat being too inaccurate/ clunky for large groups of enemies.   Their logic is basically: Game hard= bad.   The combat is fluent, and feels satisfying as it is brutal. However the player absolutely MUST utilize to the fullest extent dodging with melee using the A & D keys if you're playing on a keyboard and mouse. It's not even that reflex based, you can literally just hold A or D when battling enemies and you will automatically dodge enemy melee attacks. Death animations are usually around 3 to 5 seconds. Also it's worth mentioning that the time it takes to load the game after a death is minimal granted you have an SSD (I mean if you have the specs to run this on PC, why in the hell would you not have upgraded to an SSD at this point?). I think part of the problem is gamers today are so pampered with mindless button mash BS, where as long as you get the first shot in, you're almost guaranteed not to die. I am doing my first playthrough on medium difficulty, and so far as long as you are proactive with not spamming attacks too much, and watching when enemies are about to strike and being proactive with switching between the A & D keys to dodge effectively, you will be absolutely fine.   The graphics are absolutely stunning, the lags are there... it's not an amazingly optimized game at the moment but once again, this can be fixed down the road, it does not take away from the fact that the core gameplay is phenomenal.   The audio and voice acting are other strengths I found this game to have.

把我微博上的粘贴过来        游戏整个流程下来花了28个小时(还不算大地之子的时间)基本上走了三光路线，整体难度适中，没有恶心到我的关卡和boss，几乎每个npc都交流过，玩儿下来整体给我的感觉就是，这是个很完整的游戏。        优点挺多的，画面我就不吹了，像素现在都这么卷了吗？？那个水的效果是怎么做出来的啊太夸张了！那个光！那个水！甚至之后到了“未来”，那个雪地他妈的居然还有脚印效果，就离谱，真的很厉害。音乐给我的感觉中上，有几首非常好听，大部分时间音乐贴合场景和氛围，还有角色的心情，很不错。        操作比我想象中好太多了，可能是之前几部国产游戏(我就不点名了)给我的操作差这个感觉印象太深，以至于真正战斗开始我觉得非常惊讶，居然还挺不错的！游戏用手柄玩儿会更舒服，武器快捷键设置的也很合理，但是引导做的不是太够，我真的看到好几个up切武器不用快捷键[允悲][允悲][允悲][允悲]，看着都累死了。还有就是钱的获得，除非你特别去刷，中后期其实感觉是有点不够的，哪怕开了很多宝箱也一样，后期各种升级走扎堆给，感觉不是特别合理。地图解密也中规中矩，隐藏也难度适中，只要走三光90%的隐藏是能找到的，而且有提示音。boss战难度也适中，所有boss我都是一遍过，需要一定的走位，讲道理约翰的料理才是无敌的，谁吃了都说好[awsl][awsl]        剧情中规中矩，有一点我觉得比较不到位的就是哪怕玩儿到最后我也不太了解“妈妈”的动机，她为什么想要引发黑潮，为什么想要毁灭人类，这个没交代请就会导致角色塑造上出蛮大问题，尤瓦对主角的感情确实有点突兀，但是我觉得无伤大雅，可能是为了体现黑潮的恐怖，说实在的，我他妈对黑潮也有阴影了，这个鬼东西。。。(所以我到现在对“妈妈“这个角色全无好感，什么神经病啊就欠一顿平底锅揍)除了这个其他大部分npc的塑造我觉得真的很棒，有血有肉，有喜有悲，举个例子力哥，真的太喜欢他了。        主角这边约翰，这大叔简直。。。太帅了，虽然一句台词都没有(喂）但是就是，很帅，非常帅，可恶我也想要约翰这样的人保护我，又能打又不多话还超级会做菜，每次他掏出平底锅保护珊的时候我都很感动。 珊给我的感觉太复杂了，我很喜欢她纯真可爱又天不怕地不怕的性格，但是因为末世这个前提，她的纯真有时候会给你一种特别残忍的感觉，那种撕裂感，会让你对她的感觉特别复杂，但是，她真的太可爱了，小表情太多了2333        整体沉浸感很强，前提是你要喜欢这种类型的游戏，很多人不太适应节奏可能会觉得拖沓，但是我还蛮喜欢逛街的，不然这28个小时都他妈花哪儿去了(不是)。        制作组在设计时候加了很多小细节，npc各种各样的小动作，前期珊跟着约翰，从地底到地面，她面部表情是很快乐的，肉眼可见的快乐，后期会慢慢变化，最后会随着剧情变得坚毅，没有了之前如一张白纸一样的纯真，但是你能感受到她情绪上的变化。       总之整体下来，这个游戏完整，好玩儿，画面好，音乐到位，虽然有些缺点，但是已经做的很棒了，68哎兄弟们！你们不要老是用268或者368的水平来要求这个已经很出色的游戏了好嘛？而且这游戏里还有个大地之子呢！相当于两份游戏了！反正我不仅steam买了ns也重新买了一份支持，因为这个游戏他值得。

Mit seinem realistischen Ansatz, der detaillierten Umgebungsgestaltung und dem herausfordernden Gameplay verdient Ready or Not eine Bewertung von vier Sternen.  Das Gameplay von Ready or Not ist tiefgreifend und anspruchsvoll. Spieler müssen taktische Entscheidungen treffen, Teamkommunikation koordinieren und präzise Schüsse abgeben, um erfolgreich zu sein. Das Spiel legt Wert auf realistisches Verhalten von KI-Gegnern und bietet verschiedene Missionstypen, darunter Geiselrettungen, Drogenrazzien und Bombenentschärfungen. Die harte Realitätsnähe des Spiels macht es zu einer Herausforderung, die sowohl Geschicklichkeit als auch strategisches Denken erfordert.  Die Umgebungen in Ready or Not sind detailreich gestaltet und bieten eine realistische Kulisse für die taktischen Operationen. Ob es sich um ein Wohnhaus, ein Lagerhaus oder ein Bürogebäude handelt, die Level sind gut strukturiert und bieten viele Möglichkeiten für verschiedene Herangehensweisen. Die Beleuchtung und Soundeffekte tragen zur Immersion bei und verstärken das Gefühl der Spannung und Bedrohung.  Ein weiterer positiver Aspekt von Ready or Not ist das Waffen- und Ausrüstungssystem. Das Spiel bietet eine große Auswahl an realistisch modellierten Waffen und taktischer Ausrüstung. Spieler können ihre Ausrüstung anpassen und verschiedene Loadouts für verschiedene Missionen erstellen. Das Waffenhandling ist präzise und befriedigend, was zu einer guten Spielerfahrung beiträgt.  Ein potenzieller Kritikpunkt von Ready or Not sind technische Probleme und Bugs, die gelegentlich auftreten können. Einige Spieler haben über Abstürze, Performance-Probleme und andere Fehler berichtet. Obwohl die Entwickler an Patches und Updates arbeiten, können diese Probleme das Spielerlebnis vorübergehend beeinträchtigen.  Die Singleplayer-Kampagne von Ready or Not bietet eine solide Spielerfahrung, aber der Mehrspielermodus ist der Höhepunkt des Spiels. Zusammen mit Freunden oder anderen Spielern in kooperativen Missionen zu arbeiten, erhöht den Spaß und die Herausforderung erheblich. Die Zusammenarbeit und Koordination mit anderen Spielern ist entscheidend, um Missionen erfolgreich abzuschließen.  Zusammenfassend ist Ready or Not ein intensiver taktischer Shooter mit einem realistischen Ansatz, der Fans von taktischen Spielen und Herausforderungen begeistern wird. Die detaillierten Umgebungen, das anspruchsvolle Gameplay und das Waffen- und Ausrüstungssystem tragen zum Gesamterlebnis bei. Obwohl technische Probleme auftreten können und die Singleplayer-Kampagne nicht so stark ist wie der Mehrspielermodus, ist Ready or Not eine empfehlenswerte Wahl für Spieler, die nach einem realistischen taktischen Shooter suchen.

I've just spent some time with Devil May Cry V, and I have to say, I'm extremely disappointed with what Capcom has served up.  First of all, let's talk about the controls and camera. Both are just absolute garbage. I found myself constantly struggling to execute even the simplest of maneuvers, and the camera seemed to have a mind of its own, making it almost impossible to keep track of what was happening on the screen. It's like the developers were so focused on trying to make the game look cool that they forgot to make it actually playable.  And speaking of trying to look cool, can we talk about how cheesy and campy this game is? I mean, come on. The characters are so over-the-top and ridiculous that it's hard to take any of it seriously. I get that this is supposed to be a stylish action game, but the level of cringe in this one is just off the charts. I found myself rolling my eyes so hard that I nearly sprained something.  And don't even get me started on the PC port. It's a complete mess. The game is unoptimized and buggy, with frequent crashes and glitches. I had to spend hours tweaking settings and downloading patches just to get it to run somewhat smoothly. It's like Capcom didn't even care about the PC audience and just phoned it in with this one.  Overall, I have to say that Devil May Cry V is a massive disappointment. It's a poorly made game that's not even worth your time, let alone your money. It's just another example of how Capcom has completely lost touch with what gamers want, and instead chooses to churn out trash after trash. Save your money and skip this one.

Dragon Ball Xenoverse ofrece una experiencia extremadamente disfrutable no solo para los fans de la franquicia, cualquiera que entienda mas o menos sobre la historia de Dragon Ball Z puede disfrutar las maravillosas mecanicas de combate, las opciones de personalizacion y las miles de horas de rejugabilidad que el juego ofrece.  Para entrar en detalle, el sistema de combate es profundo y simple a partes iguales, con un teclado todo queda al alcance (literalmente) de tus manos, lo cual es notable en un juego que ofrece tantas opciones diferentes de combate, aprovachando al maximo los botones, una decision de diseño orientada obviamente a la jugabilidad con mando, que sin embargo se traduce perfecatamente al mouse y teclado; mas alla de los detalles tecnicos, los combates son gratificantes de un modo que pocos juegos logran, los efectos de sonido e imagenes consiguen transmitir una sensacion de velocidad frenetica, que disfraza perfectamente los espacios de tiempo que te permiten reaccionar a los ataques de la IA, y que al mismo tiempo da espacio para usar tus propias tecncias y desarrollar un estilo de combate propio.  Por otro lado, los detalles externos a los combates flaquean un poco, Toki Toki City es miles de veces mejor que un menu plano, pero hacen falta elementos de interactividad, con el tiempo se llega a volver un menu muy lento por el cual navegar para ir de una tienda al selector de misiones, aunque estos pequeños interludios de aburrimiento son poco o nada comparado con las misiones, particularmente las secundarias, que son por lo general mas complejas e interesantes que las principales.  Finalmente, todo sea dicho, la historia principal puede tener cambios en su curva de dificultad algo bruscos, es una decision de diseño entendible para de cierto modo obligar al jugador a probar las misiones secundarias, que puede llegar a ser molesto pero realmente te obliga a disfrutar aun mas del juego.  En resumen, Dragon Ball Xenoverse es un juego extermadamente disfrutable, mecanicamente muy pulido con pocas fallas sobre las cuales es facil ver para disfrutar de uno de los mejores juegos que personalmente he probado, 9/10

Атмосферный и неожиданно глубокий симулятор жизни экипажа подводной лодки во внеземных условиях. У каждого класса есть свои уникальные и проработанные механики, которые делают каждого члена экипажа занятым и полезным, не просто поощряя, а ТРЕБУЯ от игроков командной игры. Затягивающий и напряженный геймплей, простая но крайне атмосферная графика, погружающее звуковое сопровождение, и уникальный мрачноватый научно-фантастический сеттинг, который увлечет многих любителей инопланетных приключений.   В игре есть детальная система медицины: множество различных видов ранений со своими методами лечения различными препаратами и побочными эффектами, которые отражаются на раненном персонаже геймплейно.   Система электроники и механики: подводная лодка не делает вид что функционирует, а действительно функционирует. все механизмы имеют свое устройство и соединены друг с другом проводами (которые вы свободно можете переподключать и прокладывать по своему). Если выйдет из строя генератор кислорода - вентиляция лодки перестанет работать, а если кабельная коробка с выходами на освещение - судно погрузится во тьму. Если вы выкрутите реактор на выделение энергии в количестве большем, чем он отдает на потребление - он перегреется (что может привести к печальным последствиям). А если наоборот - системам судна будет недоставать энергии для своего нормального функционирования. Инженеры и механики постоянно следят за функционированием судна, что не очень простая задача.  Система крафта: из найденных и купленных припасов вы можете собирать совершенно различные предметы и механизмы, а для некоторых вам понадобится навык или чертёж.   Система репутации, фракций и квестов: цивилизация на покорённом спутнике Юпитера представлена подводными станциями (аванпостами) на которых встречаются разношёрстные обитатели. От местного руководства и обычных работяг, до несогласных с режимом повстанцев и сумасшедших культистов. Выполняя различные задания и реагируя на события на аванпостах, вы влияете на свою репутацию у фракций и на их благосостояние. Например, помогая аванпосту избавиться от враждебных существ на линиях снабжения, вы увеличиваете его популяцию и мнение жителей о себе. Репутация у фракций, в последствии, имеет свое геймплейное отражение. Например, если вы находитесь в раздоре с правительством, вас не пропустят через важный блокпост, а если вы решите устроить диверсию на аванпосте - вас там больше не захотят видеть, о чем ясно даст понять местная охрана. А при хорошей репутации, к примеру, в магазинах вам предоставят скидки на товары.  Система персонажей и прокачки: при старте игры вы создаете своего персонажа, настраивая ему внешний вид и выбирая класс. В последствии вы получаете опыт, который тратите на различные ветки прокачки персонажа, дающие вам преимущества в соответствии с вашим классом. Выполняя различные задачи (в том числе не связанные с вашим классом) вы прокачиваете навыки: ремонтируя насосы - механику, ремонтируя электроприборы - электрику, бинтуя ранения - медицину, руля судном - управление, и так далее. Разумеется, при старте у инженеров электрика будет на высоком уровне, а помощник не будет силен в медицине. Навыки влияют на эффективность (и возможность) действий, связанных с ними.  Возможности игры приятно порадуют тех, кто любит создавать свой собственный контент, начиная от ролевых сюжетов, и заканчивая полномасштабными модификацями. Прямо в игре есть встроенный редактор подводных лодок и станций, позволяющий построить что угодно. Консольных команд и режимов игры так же хватает, что позволяет фантазии разгуляться, устроив хоть бой между двумя подводными лодками, хоть сюжет исключительно на аванпосте.

They released Codename 47 – the game that was basically a first draft – then listened to feedback and improved immensely in only two years, producing a title that not only fixed their previous mistakes, but went the extra mile and made the experience engrossing, memorable, entertaining. That much more bang for your buck.  ㅤㅤㅤThe only thing they couldn't quite get right was the story. Silent Assassin has 21 missions – more than in any other Hitman game – and keeping two dozen chickens in the coop, making them into a cohesive whole requires a plot that is powerful enough in its narrative: logical, seamless, structured, able to lead the player, grip and excite them. Instead, the hapless farmer falls asleep and the chickens run away, thus becoming almost standalone experiences, since the narrative bonds that are supposed to hold them together are about as strong as a spider's web, its gossamer threads now flying at random, caught by the wind. I honestly couldn't care less about what was happening in Silent Assassin. Whenever I tried, a disappointed [i]'eh'[/i] would ultimately follow. This game does want to make you emotionally invested at times, but it's like a lanky 14-year-old attempting to benchpress 300 pounds – the ambition is there, sure, but it's just not gonna happen.  ㅤㅤㅤEven though this game lacks narrative strength, it still packs quite a punch gameplay-wise. All missions feel more fleshed out, more competent, ready to showcase new mechanics that allow many ways to complete each task. Not only are there 21 unique contracts, but the replayability factor has been increased tenfold compared to the original – 47 now has a shed where he keeps all weapons he picks up during missions, and you can go out of your way if you so wish and gather them all: a remarkable collection of shootin' irons, adorning the walls of an innocent-looking wooden shack. Moreover, the rating system makes its appearance, and your performance will be judged according to several important criteria such as the number of shots fired, civilians killed, and alarms set off; based on your stealth and aggression, the final rating is drawn up – from the lazy Mass Murderer to the eponymous and elusive Silent Assassin – and you feel a typical completionist's itch that begs, that implores to be scratched, and the devil on your shoulder is whispering: [i]'Go ahead, do everything again, but this time... be efficient. Precise. Deadly. Invisible.'[/i]  ㅤㅤㅤSpeaking of gameplay, this just in – you can now [b]save[/b] in Hitman! Therefore, experimentation and trying to think outside the box are not punished by the tedium of having to redo the entire assignment again, and if you're playing on Normal, you get seven saves per mission – [i]seven saves,[/i] ladies and gentlemen. It's like Christmas every time you accept a new contract – seven big presents, smiling parents and holiday cheer.  https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810307212 ㅤㅤㅤJust like in the first game, don't expect to find any real eye candy here, but an occasional look at a castle or whatever can still surprise you a bit: they could do that at the beginning of the century? Anything that Jesper Kyd does is genius by default, and my hand did not waver when I gave the soundtrack the maximum possible score. I guess this will become something of a tradition with this franchise.   ㅤㅤㅤThe music blends in nicely with any environment you'll find yourself in, and oh, boy – will you be going places; from Italy to Russia, Japan, Malaysia, India, and Afghanistan. Wherever you go, the most typical stereotypes will follow; in Russia, empty cities are full of barricades and there are soldiers with guns patrolling the streets, blasting first, asking questions second. In Afghanistan, almost everyone is a terrorist. And what is Japan without ninja warriors clad in black, perched on the rafters – naturally – backflipping to the floor and charging a gun-wielding assassin with a katana? Overall, the cultural portrayal has never been Hitman's strongest suit; it's endearing and innocent in its apparent ignorance, but it's never really offensive.   ㅤㅤㅤLast but not least, bugs and glitches, the number of which has been greatly reduced, still pop up occasionally; no crashes to desktop or anything like that, but broken animations and T-poses will appear here and there, reminding you that no matter how polished this game is, it's not perfect – technical limitations, 2002, the whole shebang. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817187660 ㅤㅤㅤ📌So, with its inventive mechanics, expert game design, excellent soundtrack and insane replayability, Silent Assassin is a title that should not and cannot be ignored by fans of the genre. 男主上来就杨过了，真不错，抛弃肉体机械飞升才是王道~       第一眼感觉很好，人物也是写实画风，就是对21:9屏幕的用户不太友好，需要玩家自己去论坛寻找补丁。一旦有了补丁，拿带鱼屏游玩本作可就太爽了！操作也不是很难，前期用V来打经常能打出双s或者三s，对于动作游戏手残而言自动战斗好快乐啊。       对于我这个新人玩家而言，让我最喜欢的是游戏中各种独具特色的恶魔，起的名字和介绍也十分中二。好棒呀，上次给我这种感觉的还是去年上半年的老头环呢。不知道为什么，很想操控一下恶魔视角，看看被主角们暴打是一种什么样的感觉。       剧情方面，刚玩的时候一脸懵逼，毕竟是刚刚接触鬼泣系列，对各种设定都感到很新鲜。游戏结束后去补了一下前作的剧情介绍，才明白前因后果的一切，看来这个故事还有许多可以挖掘的地方。游戏高潮期又看到了经典桥段：我是你父亲！哈哈哈哈，怎么说呢，一开始星球大战电影那会儿这种设定还挺意外的，但是到了今时今日，不知道怎么就越发想笑了。       如果你有耐心看到这里，那我就要讲一些私货了。这游戏给我最大的体验就是“血统万能论”，龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠儿子会打洞，通篇都是神仙打架罢了，似乎是出生决定了结局呢。是人战胜了恶魔吗？非也，到头来还是恶魔本身击败了魔界的力量。这就好比日漫《超时空要塞》中，面对外星人的威胁，人类不是靠自己的力量击败强敌，而是依靠外星人良心发现或者外星混血儿。到头来有一种给人类找了个“大爹”的感觉，有点像把战时军事指挥权交给美国的韩国人，莫名有趣了。嗯，再想想这毕竟是卡普空制作的游戏，也就豁然了。      不管怎么说，体验相当爽快，好游戏，期待续集哦~

倍感意外的好作品，美国的虚伪和苏修的狂妄都展现得淋漓尽致。 起初看到B站的实况，感觉单人剧情很短，心想着估计就是草草了事的单人战役，不曾想这次制作组整了个好活儿。 本作一反以往使劲黑苏的状态，而是美苏两国各打五十大板。无论是像美国那样往盟友城市底下埋核弹，还是像苏联那样为了创造新世界而引爆美国核弹，两者都太过离谱。离谱的点在于，游戏中的行为对于美国太写实了，人家能监听德国、法国、韩国等盟友的高官电话，甚至早些年跳脸默克尔，瞒着盟友搞搞核扩散毫不意外；至于苏联阵营，就当是80年代初期、苏勋宗末年最后的疯狂吧（看到戈尔巴乔夫真是吐了）。 主人公是个可怜人，开篇被抓后惨遭CIA洗脑和植入记忆，经历各种折磨，一次次将子弹射向自己的同志，好在结局的选择权在玩家手中。 三个结局都打出来了，北约结局是真恶心，工具人最后还是被抛弃了。最令人感动的就是苏联结局了，我们不仅仅活下来了，而且赢得了同志们的欢迎和尊重。当苏军长官摘下面具，说出人人都是“珀修斯”的时候，能让玩家深刻感受到集体主义的震撼！ 画面、配乐和枪感一如既往好评，就算只是玩单人剧情，也是非常值得的，探索格鲁乌那一关特别好玩，如果能多点这样多种选择路线的关卡就好了，总而言之建议购买吧。

[quote]并非只有太阳和白羽能与天空相伴 关注：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41411728/]白羽夜鉴赏[/url] ，吾辈同道一起探索游戏大千世界 加入：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/WhitefeatherTeaparty]白羽夜茶会[/url] ，四海皆友共同领略游戏无限风光 [/quote]  [h1] 本文可能有轻微的剧透，请各位同学酌情观看 [/h1] [h1] 前言 [/h1] 喜欢上女孩子，是不被允许的吗？由学院指派的暂定之友，对她们萌生的朦胧恋情。平和的校园生活里，却出现了学生不自然消失的现象…… 少女们将在这学院里见证什么，又将抓住什么呢——  [h1] 游戏介绍 [/h1] 《FLOWERS》是由Innocent Grey制作的清水百合向游戏系列作品，同时也是Innocent grey向全年龄向市场所迈出的第一步，从结果上来看是挺成功的。 《FLOWERS -Le volume sur printemps-》是《Flowers》系列的第一部（副标题译为“春天的篇章”），以下统称为春篇。 春篇的故事围绕主角白羽苏芳展开，本作中可攻略的角色共计两位，分别是花菱立花和匂坂真由理。  [h1] 故事介绍 [/h1] 故事发生在圣彗星兰学院，一所全宿制教会女子学院，位于森林深处，可以说是与世隔绝。为了让学生更快适应寄宿生活，这所学院运行着一种特别的制度，“Amitie“（译为友谊，朋友）——它会对学生进行分组，指定彼此互为“朋友”。主人公白羽因为一些原因蜗居在家，不曾上过学，也未曾与同龄人交流过，十分憧憬被朋友包围的生活，因此选择就读这所学院。在这里，白羽会面对友情与爱情，并从中获得救赎。 春篇共计9个章节（算上序章），其中有4个章节具有推理环节，在此环节中，玩家需全部选择正确的选项才能得出真相，否则推理失败。（这里吐槽一下：虽然每个情节的逻辑说得过去，但有些问题对玩家的知识储备量要求过高，初见难以选择正确，故合理运用社区功能）  [h1] 音乐 [/h1] 春篇共计19首，每首都挺不错的，感觉心灵都被净化了。而且op非常上头，游戏中演出也十分优秀，最近一直在听， 霜月遥的声线太合适了。  [h1] 个人体验 [/h1] 虽然白羽在对话中经常插入电影或是小说中的句子，但基本上都有注解，所以并不会影响理解。推理部分对于我这个推理苦手来说太难了，第一个推理甚至是靠穷举过的。  [h1] 总结 [/h1] [b] 优点：细腻的描写，清新的风格，合适的甜度 [/b] [b] 缺点：部分情节略缺失逻辑，结局有些许突兀 [/b] 春篇的美术风格柔和细腻，对细节的描写详细，同时汉化方面做的很好。此外春篇中有许多小细节，例如通关后开始界面与BGM的变化，对话框右上角百合的绽放程度，再如角色的名字都取自花，而这些花的花语都十分符合人物的性格。

已经将这款游戏玩完一年整了，我常在想如此大的文本量会更适合小说吗？游戏这个载体真的适合那么大题材的内容和宏大主体吗？   现在想想，可能电子游戏更具有交互性的形式更能承载这部那么庞大的时代交响曲。极乐迪斯科告诉我们，在马列主义的教导和社会主义的生活环境下长大的人也可以做出这种有着丰富意识形态斗争的艺术品，而不是单一的主旋律作品。主创团队们借一个一个各个阶层的人物之口表达出了对那个动荡社会的辩白，并且以一个相对简单易懂的口吻，这也是对游戏载体的妥协。我想如果完全脱离了这个载体，主创团队们可以更淋漓尽致的发挥。  从内容上看，意识形态的斗争充斥着这个社会的每个角落，从我好友的不推荐评论来看，这部作品可能也多少存在着一些主创对自我意识形态的输出，而不是简单客观的从某个政治立场来对于其他思潮进行批判。但对于一部政治主体的作品来看，形式和内容已经足够震撼了。极乐迪斯科带给我的记忆点很多，之前的游戏而言我常关注他们的玩法，而它给我多是一些人物自身真假立场的刻画和荒诞的人物对话。哪怕是一部电子游戏，每个人物身上也不止有一个标签，而我们这里意识形态斗争的文艺作品，却把其中每个人打上单一的标签。  今年苏共亡党亡国三十年了，意识形态的斗争永远不会结束，下一个是谁呢？  感谢这部来自于苏联时代的贵重礼物。

There's something fundamentally addicting about this game that's hard for me to understand, like it's a perfect mix of simplicity and complexity. It's a game that's deep, but easy to understand. For example, moving the enemies is a pivotal part of gameplay that's easy to underestimate at first. Enemy ranks take turns, with the rank who's turn it is being locked at the start of your turn. This means, if you move enemies to the other rank, they miss their turns. If the only enemy in the turned rank is moved to the other rank, the enemies miss their turns entirely. It's a big reason the Bilhook and the Quarterstaff have become my favorite weapons in the game. The Quarterstaff causes crippling, allowing it to do more damage by itself, but the Bilhook has more weapon damage, and pairs better with weapon damage cards.  Also, I really like the artstyle. Realistic anthros are underrated.

[h1]好游戏[\h1]  [h1]但是有点难玩[\h1]  [h1]但是好游戏 !!![\h1]  优点 : 1.单位弹药量限制.没有补给寸步难行,直升机真的好用,但分分钟吃完一车补给,打仗真的烧钱. 2.单位操作快捷键居然是键盘左侧4x4按键,方便,而且还蛮合理的,让我成功从暴雪RTS快捷键思路解放了出来. 3.在敌人依仗楼房和炮兵打巷战的调教下,明白了光靠步兵或坦克步战车推进是纯白给,学会了步坦协同. 4.烟雾弹永远的神,怪不得要单设置一个命令,玩家手动释放. 5.建筑能被毁坏做的很棒.如果能让我更细致的了解建筑被破坏到什么地步,对驻扎部队有什么影响就更好了.  缺点: 1.居然没有路径 (shift) 这个RTS的精华操作之一,这意味着我要成倍的增加对部队和战场情况的实时关注,尤其是在部队变多,战线变长的情况下,伴随来回切屏,简直折磨.这是整个游戏消耗我精力的最大原因.(被迫理解了一个人指挥三到四个单位时效果最好,所以经常把部队编成三到四个一组) 2.工兵临近地雷,地雷才会被发现的想法很棒,但是只有发现地雷才能拆地雷的设计思路很吐血,一周目没有背板的情况下,作为指挥官的我,本来应该默认很多地方都有地雷的,所以应该步坦加工兵协同推进,但我很清楚,在第一个缺点的加持下,这样最稳妥的精细的操作会累死我,我理解我的角色是指挥官,不应该学蒋公微操,但是即使在叙利亚,经过训练的士兵素质也不能这么差吧,所以大多数情况下我拿士兵和载具肉身踩雷发现位置,然后读档排雷,这样的游戏体验真的太差了.      我能想到的改良方法:      1.工兵发现的敌方地雷后永久显示,并且图标更明显,因为作为指挥官,我从工兵得到的信息就应该是经过工兵排查后的地区哪里安全哪里危险,而不是工兵知道面前有一颗地雷,转头就忘了.      2.给工兵一个可以画出排雷范围的命令,画出后,这个范围可以分为两个状态:状态1:工兵在范围内仅搜索地雷.状态2:搜索并排除地雷.  或者直接给指挥官一个划范围的命令,并可以分配工兵到范围内执行具体命令,类似钢铁雄心画战线和把师分配到战线的操作(划范围分配部队执行命令的操作搞不好能玩出花来).      3.增加地图标记功能并且在小地图和大地图上都能显示,配合工兵状态1,可以实现发现雷区范围并绕过的操作. 3.到死我也没明白日灸TOS-1怎么开炮.火箭炮和迫击炮的命令逻辑不应该差不多么?  希望制作组再接再厉,能出个俄乌战争就太棒了.

I only have 6 hours on this game as of writing this review but my general impression of this game is that it's a poor man's binding of isaac. The gameplay, while initially fun, quickly begins to feel the same. As you go from room to room you realize that there isn't much variety as this game lacks collectible items in a traditional sense. Instead you collect mounts which provide you with additional attacks. These mounts eventually disappear forcing you to grab another mount. Unfortunately most mounts have extremely similar abilities. One that acts as a dodge/block. Two that shoot projectiles, and a super that while the most different from mount to mount does boil down to a large barrage of projectiles. The only difference you will experience from run to run is the stat upgrades you gain as you kill enemies but these stat upgrades have minimal effect beside ensuring you can scale with the enemies.

Great game!  The standout features for me were:  1. The intriguing story which you can learn much more about from finding items and reading. However, for the person who does not want to take the time to do that, it is not required and the base story is great.  2. Great graphics and game mechanics. I personally really enjoyed the combat system and the variety of enemies.  3. The DLC was great, the two extra sections give much more information on the FBC, challenge the player, and provide fresh new areas.  4. Finally I really enjoyed the amount of side quests and other objectives that were not part of the main story. It fits really well with what the main character is supposed to be doing and really makes the player feel a part of the world and the FBC.   Overall I highly recommend taking the time to immerse yourself in the game and take over as the director of the FBC, it is a very worthwhile experience.   Side Note: The game did not crash once for me, only one minor bug that was easily fixed by saving and quitting.

I had the privilege of playing through the Prologue before its official release date. I had only minor gripes with the game and will absolutely be playing the full game on it’s release.  The story is set in a futuristic Indonesia and the story starts with a rather confronting choice our character has to make before you take control of him. It gives you only a taste of what the story is with our character Setyo and I’m looking forward to finding out more. Love the graphics. The art has the retro pixel feel but with a nuanced modern touch. Really quite beautifully done. I’ve played a side scroller game before which felt super limited, however this one offers more depth. It’s not just left to right. There is more to the world and I appreciated that.  I couldn’t figure out of if the text hadn’t received a proper read through or if it was imitating the way that certain cultures speak in English? But I stumbled over reading some of the lines. Not the end of the world, but still something I noticed. My biggest gripe was that I couldn’t choose to save. Or I couldn’t find a way to. I had to restart the game because I had made some wrong choices and the save just put me smack dab back into the middle of that wrong decision and so I kept dying. Frustrating.  An interesting premise of a story with graphics that are right up my alley and I’m a sucker for a detective game. Can’t wait to see the finished product!

Pleasure Climb is the second steamy game from PinkySoul on Steam and it's nothing like the previous one. While we're still dealing with pixel art it is not a simple swap puzzle like a lot of titles at this price. Get this or get a bag of chips. Tough choice?  So, if not puzzle game what do we have here? Well, I would call it a casual adventure game with basic RPG elements sprinkled with a silly story. You, as an ambitious magician, have a goal of reaching the top of a tower to receive a wish. Multiple enemies await you on your journey to the top. The main, and almost only, gameplay/combat mechanic is to press a key at a right moment in order to hit a green field, thus, dealing a damage to your opponent. In case you miss the target you are the one getting hit. Pretty simple really. Enemies have their own active battle bar indicating their attack when full. You can reset their bar when you hit them but not always. Combat sure is repetitive but some variety lessens the monotony. Your character also has stats like life, mana, atk etc. that can be improved using gold obtained after battles. You can also buy skills to ease your challenge. Speaking of which, the difficulty increases gradually as you get closer to the top. There is also hard mode that raises the bar considerably but within reason. It is a pretty simple casual game that should last a few hours. If you enjoy similar casual titles then it is worth checking but don't set your expectations high, it is a budget title for a reason.  As mentioned above, the art here is of pixel variety. Every stage boss has an animated h-scene that can be re-watched in the gallery once unlocked (big boss stages). All is very much pixelated so don't expect much here but it is still done reasonably well considering the budget character of this title.  Music is pretty basic. Nothing memorable and little variety. Simple SNES like tunes match the budget quality of this product but it is not terrible at least.  No bugs encountered.  Overall, a fairly decent budget adventure with a simple RPG elements and bit repetitive battles. Also, animated pixel art and RPG maker-like music. It is good enough at this price so if you don't mind budget titles it might be fun enough: 5.2/10

Amo mucho Shenmue; sin embargo, quiero ser lo mas objetivo posible, separando mi fanatismo con sus aciertos y sus defectos. - Gráficos:  Como pro puedo decir que los paisajes y como esta distribuido las ciudades es maravilloso, sabe explotar muy bien el motor Unreal Engine 4 en este aspecto. Como contra puedo decir que el punto anterior es su nemesis en cuestion a el modelado de algunos personajes, los que son clave (Como Ryo, Shenhua y otros que ya se deducen cuales son) se ven espectacular, se nota el mimo en ellos, pero no puedo decir lo mismo de los NPC's, se ven a medio cocer, y sin decir que algunos se ven muy tiesos (Como en la vieja escuela XD)  - Jugabilidad y mecánicas: Como pro es que Ryo ahora es menos tieso que antes, tiene cámara libre y ademas ahora nos dejan personalizar los trajes a Ryo y a Shenhua, son limitados y algunos muy caritos pero lo valen. Como contra lo pongo en el modo de combate (según mi parecer), es un cambio muy rotundo, y mas aun si vienes de jugar de corrido el Shenmue 2, se vuelve como un combate por turnos pero con cierta libertad, puedes adaptarte siempre y cuando le dediques un buen tiempo a Dojo (Volveré a hablar sobre este mas adelante porque telita...) Recomiendo muchísimo meter los mods que están en la pagina de Nexus Mods, para conseguir la experiencia lo mas parecida posible a los clásicos gozando de las virtudes del 3. (Cámara clásica, nuevos shaders, no consumir nuestra vitalidad con el solo hecho de existir XD, entre otros mas)  - Historia:  Después de tanto por fin la historia tiene cierto progreso; sin embargo, no es muy gordo como lo fue el 1 y el 2, ya que se siente que en ciertos puntos el juego extiende el chicle a la mala, como por ejemplo la de hacernos perder aun así derrotemos al matón de turno, ademas que no progresarás si no le dedicas todo el tiempo posible en subir tus habilidades en el dojo, y sin mencionar que te obligará a comprar ciertos artículos obligatorios para el lore, aparte de los libros de técnicas de pelea (carísimos si seguimos el juego así como esta planteado, recomiendo mucho farmear) Como plus puedo decir que lo jugoso del lore está casi finalizando el juego, ya que ahí están los puntos claves.  - Conclusión: Si buscas adentrarte a esta saga recomiendo mucho empezar con el I & II, si te ha gustado estos dos, entonces también agarraras el gusto por la tercera parte, ya que este juego es hecho por fans, para fans Mi voto será positivo por el hecho de que la saga Shenmue está mas viva que nunca, incluyendo el anime  Psdt: Gracias Yu Suzuki por volver a traer el juego que revolucionó todo, solo esperamos que el IV no salga de aqui otros 18 años XD

云层一下子炸裂开来，霎时间天地灵气激增，原本有着雷劫的地方散出渺渺仙光，只看得天空之上楼阁层叠，有着几道身形立于楼阁之前。  “仙界啊……” 白露和林沐心都望着仙界出神。  但是只有那道身影和玄伶，一眼都没有看那巍峨仙域。  他们眼中只有对方的身形。  “要是我飞升了，肯定高兴死了！”这是林沐心  “若我有朝一日飞升，或许心情会如往常一般平和吧。”这是白露。  “那玄伶姐姐你说……” 渡劫和我想的不一样，轻松的不像是最后的劫难，我什么都没干，每回合点击不超过五下，等到度过劫后，我想和他们包括我的道侣玄伶说几句话，但是我发现已经不行了，我就这么飞升上了仙界，好像和尘世没了瓜葛。  我很难过 真的很难过  这是我最后看着玄伶几个人想到的一点文 我把自己当成一个旁观者看着他们的一言一行，这个时候我才真正带入了我自己，其实想一想，我只不过是过客 他们才是一直存在的人  想到这里我又有点宽慰  我想 我的故事已经结束了，但是他们的故事还没有，我只是失去了继续观看的权利  即便我已经不在了  其实我觉得通讯录里的飞升标识 不如原来的失联 或者可以写死亡  写到这里，我还是很难过 我还是在想游戏里她们之后的生活  我才发现，我一直期望的游戏通关 是我的故事的结束  这个时候我才知道 我每天所经历的日常，就是一个又一个接连不断的奇迹  我想 飞升和死亡一样 一个是欺骗自己 一个是欺骗别人  写了一堆有的没的，各位就当个乐子看看，我还是希望各位入手游戏后能多去看看自己的道侣，朋友，师傅  别像我一样。  游戏是个好游戏，我从来没有对一个游戏这样痴迷，我很推荐 我也会一直玩下去  但是近期我不会打开它了  它很好玩  好玩的有点让我痛苦  就这样，希望看到的各位身体健康 再见。

Скримеров как для хоррора тут нет вовсе, тут от хоррора больше атмосфера и нагнетающая обстановка, ну, может быть и музыка. Ни капли не желею за потраченные 20 рублей на пакет молока.  Вообщем, игру одназначно рекомендую, несмотря на то что она короткая и буквально эти 15 минут,могут многое показать и рассказать вам что-то за гранью нашего разума. 虽然有点上了年头，但游戏其实还是好游戏，虽然是线性主线，但是每个角色都能做出独特的剧情，最后还来一波世界线合并操作确实不错，动作设计也比较到位 优点：虽然剧情整体中规中矩，但剧情全程CV配音，角色的CV选择也非常到位，整体代入感更强 角色动作设计独特，玩得特别花，配合相应的动效，即使在老引擎上做出来的动作效果也让人眼前一亮  具有前瞻性的背景设计，游戏在开发初期（十年前）设计的背景，概念图和建模气氛烘托上并不输某些2020年后出的一些动作手游，特别是第六区当初是作为中立区设计的概念画特别吸引人，从末世观到美少女战斗，该有的都有了 虽然游戏久远，但整体的建模和材质并没大问题，贴图上没有明显瑕疵还弥补了引擎限制的不足，美术氛围烘托也到位了  氪金和打造方面，全程角色有送礼包可以助你无压力做主线上满级，当体验一个免费的RPG玩的玩家放宽心，装备可以租， 后期刷高阶装备和打造可能比较耗时间，但是时装方面是一套商城时装就可以全开孔的，装备的话不想特别肝可以等版本末期或者大更减负，其他可能性只能是抱团蹭车了（单刷raid副本效益不高），大部分都是能用时间解决的。这点对比同期的closers要好太多，除非你追求极致打造，否则它并不是又肝又氪的存在。 缺点：城镇，刷本时不时卡顿，土豆服务器，临时维护无公告，直接维护发通知           优化差，玩久了容易掉帧，整体更吃CPu，无可奈何这游戏只是个32位的游戏，而且据说引擎都停止开发了           狗牙严重，特别在静态截图上来看，整体画面效果没有实际感觉好，上了N卡的调教可能会稍好一些           角色面部的模型面数可能偏低了，导致脸上都能看出棱角，一些时装存在明显的穿模问题，关键还是出现在套装上           通胀严重，拍卖行东西动辄上亿，点品在某些黑商手里低价出让，让所有氪金玩家都觉得自己是小丑，运营态度摆烂不管黑商，商城卖的礼包稀烂，各种随机概率性物品还卖高价。           视角问题，在释放某些技能后或跑地图边缘，会出现墙面阻挡视角的情况，不过老游戏都有这种情况，修复困难的话 ，可以 尽量避免狭窄多墙体积的地图设计           游戏社交性较弱，好友系统甚至不是账号通用的，公会同理，超多人团本的可行性暂时未知，不过记得日服N年以前中立区打中立区世界boss的时候卡成狗，个人感觉超过8人以上团本的可行性较低            角色平衡问题：目前这个服务器只做到了相对平衡，即榜佬的竞速时间差并不会特别大，但是实际刷本上大众如果去玩的话角色的上下限还是有很大的差距，比如输出环境安逸，无敌技能时间长且容错高的幻神角色能站撸各类raid（不举例了，看榜就知道了，男角某个很强，但玩的人不算特别多），而操作难度高的角色，没有吸血，没有技能减伤，回血慢的角色需要很大的操作空间才能打出幻神角的对等输出，加上后期的副本设计很多都是打桩，打桩机角色更容易站桩输出boss了（事实上现在排名也是按照输出来排的，大致上这游戏就是个无脑输出游戏，同时这游戏影响输出最大的一个数值就是防御力贯穿，所以大部分自带贯穿的角色都不弱，至少下水道里没有），所以也导致很多人妥协了转生去玩幻神角放弃自己喜欢的角色，毕竟也有玩家肯定不能接受同毕业的装备 幻神角次次组队排名都比你下水道高(这次更新的新角，即剪刀，给我的感觉是数值上面完全碾压其他角色的一个幻神角，不单单是技能倍率，包括角色基础面板+增益buff上完全的碾压，以至于我严重怀疑这角色的数值有偏向性设计且是故意的)。         联机bug多，諸如79妖精副本一旦抓人后破SA必出bug，甚至可以全程卡怪物模型，後續的黃金王副本卡視角，开局不给觉醒等等，各类角色的召唤物在某些玩家电脑上可能会卡，比如娜飞的地雷，吉他的爷爷，莉莉的死神这类召唤物，导致帧数下降，目前没遇到过，但组副本排泄某依赖召唤物的角色的情况依然存在。         副本机制对新人不友好，新人无人帮忙做装难，我拉了两个朋友玩，基本上是换72套去打72raid还勉强的程度，伤害刮中刮，吐槽这游戏的副本机制是真的不行，而且看起来这种情况组队76raid也会被很多队拒，因为贵游机制有特恶心的跑圈（踩不到点或没达成条件即全场秒杀）也就导致了游戏学习成本高，且容错低，提高容错的方法要么找个公会或者小团体，抱团刷图或找人带或者硬着头皮练好技术干单人做装，单人干装按月来算如果还得是手搓齐还不如等更新减负，raid副本限制复活，限制时间阶段（阶段限制掉落），开招募后解除有十分钟冷却，和boss同归，或蹭车最后队友打死boss自己死亡结算后不会自动复活（封印者甚至都有结算后复活）等等，很多折磨人的机制LG你觉得有必要吗？一个小众游戏，如果单纯的让新人觉得折磨，基本上是很难留住散人的       但是，如果你是个体验剧情后顺便做做日常来慢慢收集不容易迭代的AR卡或者时装，装备等送或减负的佛系玩家，或者是社牛喜欢和人一起打本的，我还是推荐这款游戏的，我觉得一些方面开发组应该也有做努力，但影响玩家体验的问题我认为还是应该优先解决

Соглашусь, у игры есть проблема с оптимизацией, но разработчики в последний год так круто поддерживают проект, что слов нет. Каждую неделю выходит крупное обновление с кучей нововведений и фиксов!  Игра максимально интересна и погружает в хардкорный мир выживания. Пробовал играть в соло около 50ч+ - это весьма сложно, потом начал играть с приятелем в двоем и уже комфортно проходится большинство миссий. Контента в игре точно на несколько сотен часов, если брать ИСКЛЮЧИТЕЛЬНО компанию (миссии) по 2ум разным картам, помимо этого открытый мир - очень интересная фишка, где можно расслабиться, делать то, что хочешь - построить дом своей мечты, нафармить экзотики и отправить ее на орбиту, нафармить кучу ресурсов и открыть кучк технологий, да еще и уровень отлично можно вкачать! Впечатления достаточно положительные и я обязательно рекомендую купить данную игру! А теперь моя оценка:  ====[Интерес (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Очень много разнообразного контента в виде заданий, а также возможность играть в открытом мире!   ====[Сложность (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Игра достаточно хардкорная и больше подойдет любителям выживача. Однако компанией в 2-3 человека можно спокойно и комфортно играть   ====[Сюжет (⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Сюжет раскрывается при прохождении определенных миссий постепенно, но это далеко не главная часть игры. Можно узнать о том, какие фракции есть, за что отвечают. По-сражаться с боссами, по-добывать экзотику.   ====[Требования к железу (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== С оптимизацией проблемы присутствуют. На слабом ПК игра будет работать не очень.   ====[Графика (⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Графика хорошая, приятная, весьма реалистичная.. вот только огонь и пожары выглядят немного кринжово :D   ====[Моды (⭐️):]==== На момент написания обзора - модов в игре нет, да они тут на самом деле и не нужны, контента достаточно)   ====[Аудио сопровождение (⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Погружает в игру, хорошее сопровождение   ====[Баги(⭐️⭐️):]==== Багов почти нет. Играть приятно, единственная проблема игры - оптимизация при переходе с одних чанков на другие   ====[Поддержка игры разработчиками (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Поддержка на высшем уровне! Каждую неделю выходит крупное обновление, где хренова куча фиксов, а также новый контент! Очень воодушевляет!   ====[Цена (⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Я считаю, что цена для такой игры оптимальна и соответствует качеству игры   ====[Время (⭐️⭐️):]==== Спокойно можно играть хоть пару часов в неделю и будет чем заняться, можно расслабиться после дневной смены   ====[Аудитория (⭐️⭐️⭐️):]==== Много кому подойдет подобная игра, если играть компанией. В соло же подойдет любителям хардкора и выживачей

Updated Review:  It's still a great game and I am addicted. However Since I got to the game +1 stage I've noticed that the workers are no longer needed. I have stopped using them period because of the fact when you are doing thousands of work per click manual compared to a hundred or less using workers, they just feel slow and useless. However I think this could easily be fixed by changing the rate of work for each level. If they made work per second double with each worker lvl they would be a lot more productive and be able to keep up with manual clicking thereby making you want to pay them to work. As it stands a lvl 10 worker does 85 work per second, so using all 10 you would get 850 work per second. On a mine that has millions that needs to be mined, this is just a downright JOKE. A 10 million stone mine at that rate would take you 11,764 seconds, that is 196 minutes = 3.26 hours to mine one mine.   GREAT! But here is the problem when you get to the + games and you have 10 ships bringing in those HUGE mines every hour, it just gets to be totally unproductive. However if you doubled the work per second for workers every lvl at lvl 10 would be doing 1024 work per second and about keeping up with manual clicking when you multiply that by 10 workers = 10240 per second and make that mine take 16 minutes to mine.  Thereby a person could mine at least a few more and come a little closer to keeping up and not feel like they are paying a bunch of bums to sit on their you know what. Anyway that is my pet peeve, not make or break for me cause all I do is restart the game over when I get to the +1 stage but yah I assume I am missing out on a lot because of the grind. Incredible game definitely my favorite in the series; I've played fnv, fo4, and f76, planning on playing fo3 next. 155 hours for full completion and I was hooked every minute of it. So many sites to explore and all the dlc's were impressive. It's very hard to have the same play through twice with so many choices and possibilities. I had to install a loading screen mod to speed them up though for pc because going through any loading door/loading screen could take 30-60 seconds which would've been unplayable with how many loads there are (not to mention reloading quicksaves). So unfortunately that cancelled the ability to get achievements with mods installed. I think there could have been a bit more of a main storyline, a lot of the time you felt alone even with the many miniquests talking to those small role npcs. I got the best weapons halfway through the story so the mobs kept getting harder but my weapons stayed the same. It eventually got to where enemies had so much hp and I was just plinking their armor which got pretty boring. Extremely memorable companions with fun companion quest lines. I had to send Preston Garvey to the south pole eventually though to stop him from giving me more settlement quests. The settlements were pretty cool to build, I play a bit of the Sims sometimes so it wasn't too bad. My 20 settlements had about 20 people per one which was fun to control an army. Overall the game had great mystery, adventure, characters, and graphics I would highly recommend.

[h1] [b]爱上火车[/b] [/h1]  这是我最喜欢的Gal之一，原因很简单，因为它的质量很高。作为一个铁道迷、飞友，这个Gal里充斥着的各种铁路名词，听起来都是那么的让人熟悉和令人兴奋。更不用提这整体的400张CG，231首歌曲BGM，70个影片，109个场景背景，和极多的立绘。 在玩爱上火车之前，我是只对电气机车感兴趣的，比如我所在的区域的LIRR(长岛铁路）以及我经常坐的M7型电联车，或者是带着4节C3的EMD DE30AC柴油机车。现在好了，对蒸汽机车也更感兴趣了（已经在着手查资料学习了）！ 如果你还在犹豫买不买，你既然都看到我了，就买了吧，绝对不会亏！（就算看不懂铁路名词，里面也有类似石头门的tips名词一览，很容易看懂，剧情里也有简单易懂的解释！）还有全语音男主欸！声音贼好听，现在的Gal属实少见！（爷真帅气）  [b]听我一句劝！如果你第一眼对八六有好感，不要提前推八六线！！！要不然你有大概率变单线战神，对你的全CG收集、成就收集有巨大影响23333[/b][spoiler] （我永远喜欢八六）[/spoiler]  [u][b]以下内容涉嫌剧透，如果你还没有通关游戏，看到上面的推荐去买了玩玩看吧！绝对好玩！[/b][/u]  最喜欢的线路是八六线，奥莉薇的那段剧情我是真的一个大男人大半夜哭的稀里哗啦的，尤其是宗方喊奥莉薇的时候，我真的哭死好吧，真不带这样的呜呜呜呜呜呜（ 咳哼——整理一下心情。八六检票那段真的很甜，真的超喜欢八六！（我永远喜欢铃！！！！！！！！！） 看到了最后奥莉薇提取制造出的两个人偶核，一个小玉，一个望，我又感动的哭了一次（心情再次激动 所以八六线对我来说是最好的结局。推了八六线又导致我推不动其他线了（因为八六在其他线都很明显的把自己的位置让了出去，极其让人心疼）  日日姬是我第二喜欢的线路，虽然中间那段日日姬成为御一夜市长那段我觉得有些略微不合理，毕竟日日姬还是个学生，突然就竞选为了市长让我感觉有点猝不及防，但仔细考虑日日姬的人设其实不难发现，日日姬在各种方面上来说都属于是天才，无论是观察能力，还是思考能力来说都是非常敏锐准确，所以当上市长的冲突感也就被减弱了很多。但谁能顶得住这妹妹啊！（德国骨科，请（无慈悲）），日日姬真可爱！！  波莱特路线感觉对火车的描写少了许多，反而是对各种危机的化解，以为了复兴铁路所做出的努力为侧重点，在后日谈部分用一段温馨而又充实的家庭旅行作为结尾。双铁，波莱特，玲奈和光，一家四口的冬季旅行让人代入感极强，让我拥有了一次非常难以忘记的旅行！（玩完这条线之后我自己尝试做温泉蛋，很好吃！！）  目前就说这三个主要线路吧（因为要是8条线全都说的话就太多了，后面还要说说总集路线和仲国路线呢）  总集路线，也称为九星线，集成了8条线路的各种事件的线路，其造成的历史结果也是最接近于现实铁路历史发展的线路。为了让自己的妹妹路子和爸爸妈妈相遇，尝试与各种人相遇，解开自己的心结，帮助摆脱大废线的影响，发展日本铁路，成立九星。相当于对之前所有的线路做了一次总结，但并没有选择任何一位女主角，但又离各位女主角很近。也是最长的路线。（我玩了得有6个小时[非连续]）  而仲国路线，豁！要说这个我可就不困了（写这篇评测的时候是凌晨1:12分）！身为一个在美国居住了9年的人，仅在19年回国玩了一个月，在那一个月里我充分的体验到了中国发展之迅速，而这一切，都在爱上火车的仲国线路里体现的淋漓尽致。就进仲国线路我就非常兴奋和激动，比如对自己熟悉的那一切，绿皮车，北京铁博，东风4型，以及国风满满的BGM，让我体会到了Lose对中国玩家和中国铁路迷的诚意。在仲国线路中对中国的描述非常准确，比如不run许拍照啊，扫码支付啊等.... 仲国线路第四章对卧铺的描写，在我还在中国的时候，那个时候回老家都是坐这种卧铺车，因此有此等对卧铺的描述，无论是换票给换票证，还是餐车，以及背景那多半是实录的火车在轨道上咣当咣当的声音，把我拉回了小时候的回忆。感触最深的是对于晚上绿皮车停靠时的那段描写： [i]而在这夜深人静中，日日姬透过窗帘掀开的一角观察，又在专心致志地画着什么。 （到底是----！） 是……星光。这星光是多么美丽啊。 耀眼的星光洒落在站台上。化作照亮站台的灯火，化作了沉眠在站台的车窗的灯火。 （绿比车……那是车底回送吗？车厢里亮着灯，是在进行打扫吗？） 全然感觉不到其他人的气息。无论是从远处站台的绿比车上，还是我们周遭的铺位上。 所有的一切都是如此寂静。而打破这一寂静的唯一例外，就来自日日姬手中的铅笔。[/i] 我真是太喜欢这段了，我在坐卧铺的时候，晚上醒来，看着自己坐的车停靠在站台边上，我会拉开窗帘的一角看外面，天上的星星和月亮，站台的灯光，对着对面亮着灯的空无一人的车厢着迷，这一段描写深深的触动了我的心。 仲国线路让我这个隔着中国大半个地球的人，来了一次令人怀念的中国旅行。并让我暗自发誓，疫情过后，再回国坐坐卧铺，再多看看祖国的大好河山。  77个小时，通关了爱上火车的我对这段旅途回味无穷，回首望去，那个因为铁路事故而憎恨铁路的双铁，已经成为了推动全球铁路发展事业的重要领头人，而我则通过这些故事对铁路的感情变得更深。我相信，进行豹也是想通过《爱上火车》，使得更多人，爱上火车。  感谢读到这里的你！

Amazing game! The graphics are still pretty good, even in 2020. Great lighting, great 3D models for objects, good models for monsters / people. The sound mixing is very good, even without headphones it's very ambient and immersive. The music beautiful, I'm honestly thinking about getting a hold of the soundtrack. The art is amazing too, it's style really adds to the feeling of somber & mystery the game creates.  The story is very interesting and engaging. I really like how we find things out backwards, it's iconic even now. They did a really good job making the characters very gray, despite everything. They would do something horrible, yet you could still sympathize with why they did it. The storytelling is also pretty amazing. The game tells us everything through various methods. The flashbacks, the letters & notes, cut-scenes, etc...  Other things I personally liked was how freaky the monsters are. They're really disfigured & rotting looking humans, but in a very unnatural way. The grunt is my favorite. His upper jaw being exposed and his stitched up & barley held together body really make him properly freaky. Not horribly scary, but it doesn't need to be. I wouldn't want to be him. I also liked how period-accurate everything was. The furniture, the random items laying around, even the stamps on crates really helped with feeling like I was in a very old castle while in the 1800's.  Needless to say, I really love this game. It's a piece of art and I really enjoy it!

tl;dr Fun game, great concept and it looks pretty but dealing wih people 20x my level on a constant basis while only having 7 hours in is not fun, is discouraging and makes me wish i never bought it. Hope the devs fix the matchmaking  Let me star this by saying its a great concept, very beautiful game with great gameplay as a whole, and is enjoyable....if youre put into a fair game. My friends and i picked this game up to play as something to do outside of DayZ, so we arent new to hardcore type games. Unfortunately, the matchmaking is completely broken. We are both level 12, and after level 11 we are getting put into matches with the lowest level being at least 70 with a prestige of at least 2. Us being such a low level being thrown into full lobbies of players that have prestiged at least twice, is in my book not fair and very discouraging. When we first started playing we were put into lobbies of people anywhere from 2-20 with the occasional person being 50, 60 and rarely a 90 but absolutely no one that was prestiged. As ive said, its a fun game, i love the concept and think its pretty but to be placed in a game with someone that has prestiged 46 times is not a level playing field at all. If you think you have the patience to not only get passed the learning curve of the game, while also having to deal with players 20x your level on a very regular basis, then by all means play the game. As of right now i feel its a waste of money

Alright, first of all hear me out here. I don't know why, but my hours played won't update no matter what I do, so I've been stuck at 2.9 hours playtime although I've spent a good majority of the last few days playing. I'n thinking the actual time would be something like 13 hours, but I've just gotten past the intro.  The story is engaging, I really do like the characters and the world CDPR has managed to create. I feel like my V is who I wanted them to be, The graphics are pure eye candy and the game runs fine, although I'm not running it on anything overly powerful.  Gameplay and the controls have felt good so far. Enemies are a bit spongy at first, but when you get your hands on the more powerful stuff it can feel a bit like the overpowered gunplay of Doom all over again at times.  There are glitches for sure, but I've seen nothing so bad it would have broken my playthrough. In my experience they're mostly visual. I'm not saying the game doesn't need polish on the technical side of things, but it hasn't been as horrible as I feared. (The worst I've experienced was the time I experienced a character's eyeballs slowly slide out of their sockets and disappear during a pretty important  However, the biggest problem I personally have with the game is the fact the huge and pretty world doesn't live its own life around you. Sure, it looks like it does, but in reality it seems to only serve as the stage to the story you're a part of. There's not much to do and the world doesn't have much interactivity outside the story and side missions. NPC and the AI for civilians and police are a joke. Don't go in expecting much more from them than games 10 years back offered.

Fallout 4 is easily the best Fallout game, from a gameplay perspective. The gunplay, weapon and settlement crafting, and the character customization are, in my opinion, the best that Bethesda has ever done. As for quest structure and overall story, I would argue that Fallout 4 has the weakest of the singleplayer Fallout titles, so if you're really into Fallout for the story, I would pass on this. However, the voiced and more characterized protagonist of the game does lend itself to certain emotional heights that previous Fallouts did not achieve, such as when Father dies, or when Nick has a mental breakdown following the death of Eddie Winter, among others. As well as this, certain changes like the more wacky gun designs, as well as the changes to the power armour system, lend the game's aesthetic to a kind of wacky, over the top scifi fantasy vibe that I really appreciate, even if its not tonally consistent with previous Fallout titles. I also picked up some of the CC content, specifically the X-02 power armour, Zetan arsenal, Shroud Manor, and the modular backpacks, and I would say that most of them(besides Zetan arsenal without mods) are worth the money if you are interested in the content they give(because seriously I shouldn't need to be level 41 to convert Zetan guns to use FCs). Overall, I would say that Fallout 4 is the ultimate post-nuclear sandbox.

Игра превращается в бродилку по пустым локациям.  Управление в игре по началу непонятное, а позже и вовсе оказывается проблематичным. Сложно подбирать предметы, т.к. на некоторые из них приходилось нажимать несколько раз, чтобы игра среагировала. Интерфейс также вызывает некоторое смущение. В игре отсутствует кнопка выхода в меню – есть только кнопка выхода из игры вообще; отсутствует раздел сохранений.   Персонажи незапоминающиеся: сложно отличить одного от другого.   Как итог: в игру заходить после такого опыта особо не хочется (даже если сюжет окажется очень неплохим).

2015年的巫师3：狂猎是史上最优秀的RPG游戏之一，也是史上最伟大的游戏之一，唯一的“DLC赢得年度RPG游戏大奖”成就保持者。之后其开发商CDPR一系列的开发经营活动都不如预期，但这丝毫未影响巫师系列本身的优秀。 CDPR曾因巫师被玩家们爱称波兰蠢驴，又因2077而声名扫地，但本次的次世代更新依旧十足的良心，在巫师3上蠢驴确实是始终如一的蠢驴—— 12 月14日，NS以外的所有次世代平台都将免费迎来次世代版本更新，这可不是简单打个补丁，而是全面的加料。 次世代 技术方面，主机版本提供了“40K60帧”和“光追30帧”两种模式，相较原版而言两种模式都有极大的体验优化，PC版则可根据性能进行更多调整。此外游戏还更新了拍照模式，玩家们可以尽情拍摄威伦的树林、沼泽和山洞了。 操作方面，PS5版本添加了手柄自适应扳机和触屏的反馈效果，战斗时也有了快速切法印的选择。 版本整合了不少民间制作的优秀MOD(其实2077更需要这个)。 较之原版，游戏内还更新了与网飞剧版内容的联动任务以及不少新装备。 和初版相比，一次购买的次世代版本包含了游戏发售至今的全DLC，主要角色的全新造型、为数不少的新任务、大幅优化的系统以及震撼人心的两个史诗DLC“石之心”与“血与酒”。无论是初版没通关、打完结局就没再打开过还是通关了DLC就删游戏的玩家，次时代版本都是一个极佳的重新拾起巫师3的时机。 但是，本次更新并非所有地方都在进步，有些地方的改动让游戏体验朝着奇怪的方向急速滑去，好在每一条都是可以在选项中改回原版的。 拾取草药不用打开物品栏是好评设计，但是CDPR忘了添加显示拾取物名称的提示信息，最后反而变成了由于总是拾取了东西却不知道是哪个，让玩家不得不养成采药之前先调整视角仔细看看这棵草的名字叫什么的习惯——进入游戏十小时后，我已经学会靠外形记住草药名了。 类似于越肩的新视角固然让剧情更有沉浸感，但是CDPR忘了针对新视角优化战斗体验——也可能是忘了把优化的文件也一起更新——原本的游戏战斗作为ARPG虽然在战斗方面引起过争议但无疑是可玩的，次时代版的新视角则直接把战斗体验拉入了地狱。不像前不久发售的诸神黄昏主要问题集中在看不到背后的敌人，次世代版的战斗最常遇到的问题是“锁定了敌人然后贴身一套剑舞却发现根本没打中”和“有时候连锁定都会失效”。目前只要调回视角这问题就不复存在，但还是希望新视角存在的问题能尽快得到修复。 中文 本次更新最大的内容是中文语音，事实上所有文本都因中文语音进行了重译。和其他次世代更新不同，此次语言更新的体验之好是我推荐所有人游无论新老玩家体验巫师3次世代版本的原因——只要你不是原版通关了三四遍，地图的每一个角落都了若指掌，所有剧情文本都背得滚瓜烂熟，那这次的中文化一定能给你带来惊喜。 游戏的中文配音非常专业，CDPR为中文语音准备了更本地化的新文本、中文口型适配，甚至连游戏内的歌曲都进行了中文化。虽然台词有一些翻译腔的味道，但巫师3这样的西方奇幻世界观却反而是最适合翻译腔的。 无论是几位主要角色还是剧情中遇到的各色人等的演绎都相当有感染力，原本就经典的场景在中文演绎下能获得全新的体验，玩到某男爵的段落时我甚至希望能换来一颗没玩过巫师3的脑子来体验这段内容。 如果仅仅是演绎出色，中文无论如何也不可能取代英文称为最优解，之所以这次中文配音版能成为我推荐必玩的理由，是由于有了中文语音后，游戏的体验以及信息的接收获得了绝大的飞跃：在这个熙熙攘攘的开放世界中，说话的人实在太多，中国玩家哪怕英文再好，对于不是母语的语言依然会有一定的信息遗漏。在15年的时候我曾像游玩CRPG一样仔细阅读每一个人头顶的文本框，但对剧情的整体理解却还是不如次世代版中闲庭信步听到的闲聊。 原来某件稀有装备的位置，早在路人的闲聊中就告诉你了。 原来某个案件需要跑一大圈去找的犯人，是有目击者无意中看到过的。 原来某家擦身而过没有对话也不发任务的路人，身上也有悲惨的故事。 任务、世界观、剧情……中文配音不仅带来了更好的沉浸感，也让喜欢剧情的玩家有了对整个世界更进一步了解的机会。 要说有什么不足，大概是叶奈法的声线不够御，以及有一些杂鱼角色的声音过于杂鱼了。 CDPR 在游玩巫师3次世代版时，除了继续沉浸在猎魔人的世界中，我脑海中反复跳出的词是：“2077”。 毕竟哪怕血与酒也是2016年的事了，在那之后很多人一直抱着对CDPR的美好回忆等了四年，在这期间诸如育碧的刺客信条神话三部曲这类的游戏对巫师的游戏模式进行了不少借鉴，流程体验上也有不少厂进行过优化。 很多人都忘了，在优秀的剧情、当年还算少有的开放世界以及演出效果的背后，巫师3其实是有不少问题的：臃肿不便的UI，有待提升的战斗体验，数值设计…… 这些问题都在2077中出现了。CDPR似乎自己也被巫师的成功冲昏了头脑，觉得既然巫师3如此成功，那么一定方方面面都是成功的。 于是我们在2077中看到了同样精彩的剧情，更棒的演出，过时的开放世界，与巫师如出一辙的UI，没怎么提高的数值设计。 刨除吹破的牛皮，CDPR其实不是以做一个新游戏的觉悟，而是以巫师续作的心态去做的2077，如此一来很多事倒是更理所当然了。骄兵必败的原因，是骄兵必败。 其实我去年就知道了中文语音的事，但我没想到CDPR竟然花了两年时间打磨一个免费更新的补丁，更没想到他们给一个15年的老游戏配备了超过2077的优秀本地化。 巫师3确实是CDPR挽回口碑最快的捷径，但也不能因此否认他们投入的努力——没人会记得按时发售的垃圾游戏，除非游戏成了梗，但这也比至今还在跳脸嘲讽玩家的某先辈好太多了。 蠢驴啊，花了两年时间打好的复活甲，你可千万别在明年的往日之影就给用了。

喜欢这类型游戏的建议直接买第二部，比这部高到不知道哪里去了。 这一部性价比真的极差，之所以给好评是因为我冲了。 做人要讲良心，评价黄游一定要摸着自己的鸡巴说话。 CG部分比较粗糙，就那么几张图，我很怀疑那根忽大忽小飘忽不定的鸡巴是把马赛克擦掉后重新画上去的。 整体游戏流程较短。作者利用大量重复操作把攻略过程巧妙地拉到了2小时出头。 我不反对这种做法，毕竟人都要吃饭的，但未免显得诚意不足，因为在成功开操后我想看到的基本都没看到。 慢节奏+人妻的人设没有问题。文案虽然日式风格拉满——把人妻一顿猛抠完事还要提起裤子说声谢谢。妈的，真是太有礼貌太亚撒西了。 但可以说把握到了人妻的精髓——一点点靠近，一步步试探底线，最终吃下那颗饱满低垂的果实，享受朴素打扮下隐藏着的虎狼之年坐地吸土的强烈反差带来的巨大快感。 可是游戏到这就没了…… 虽然还有两个回忆没解锁，但我猜就是一个骑乘位一个无套，没啥新活。 游戏整体UI设计是合格的，唯独在床戏过程中不够流畅，也不知道这作者怎么想的。 反正让我没有继续刷数值的欲望。关键今天更新把我的存档整没了，真他妈操蛋。 总之后续可玩的内容太少，这就好像忙活了两小时做了一道大菜，结果才吃一口，盘子就被狗扒拉到地上去了，真是赣林老木啊。

[h1] Tentatively Recommend [/h1]  Ark is a really good game if you can see past its flaws, but boy are there a lot of them.  To start, the positive: Most of the maps, both modded and official are beautiful, even despite the game's ageing graphics, and have plenty of areas to build in for both PvP and PvE. The creatures in Ark are all so cool, and especially the newer ones have so much nuance to them, each feeling special and having different purposes. The core gameplay loop of collecting resources to tame more dinosaurs and then beating things up with these dinosaurs is very fun if you are into survival games. Of course it's a grind by default, but luckily this is another one of Ark's strengths - it is so modular. If you don't like a particular grind or feature, then you can quite easily change it, or even just turn it off by boosting settings the right amount for you. The modding scene is thriving too, and if you can't fix something you don't like in the settings, there is probably a mod for it.   Now, onto the negative:  The game features more bugs than the average forest. If you can think of a bug, it probably exists, from creatures falling through the map and dying to save files being deleted (I haven't seen this one in a while, but I'd recommend keeping save backups just in case, because it is devastating to experience). Also, the newer official maps just don't seem to have the same magic to them as the older ones. Genesis feels far too restrictive, and not in an interesting way like Aberration, while Genesis 2 is feels like 2 areas just copy pasted across a massive map for the sake of filling space (I might just be being too harsh here however, as many community members love Genesis 2). The AIs in Ark are also awful, and it is really easy to either lose a creature because it gets stuck on a tree and won't path find around it, or on the flip side, cheese kill a creature because it just runs in circles while you sit on a rock and shoot it.  Overall, I think that Ark is worth a buy because of how addictive it can be, but it might be worth holding off until a sale as the flaws can become very noticeable. I'm very hopeful for Ark 2 which is upcoming in 2023, but I'm worried that it could go either way and be excellent or horrible.

10/10 WOW, I have completed this game 4 times and have gotten every achievement there is to offer yet I still keep coming back for more. While coming into this game as a complete newbie to souls like games i wasn't sure weather i would give up at the shear difficulty but boy was i wrong.  This game is the perfect first entry point into the souls series with the game holding your hand while you learn the basics but still feeling challenging enough to push you further. There is nothing like the feeling you get when you beat that boss you have been stuck on for ages and it never gets old. While this game and other games in the franchise are known for being extremely difficult Elden ring is only as difficult as you want to be. There are plenty of early game weapons, spells and incantations that can help you get OP quickly and even for some bosses NPC's you can summon to aid you in your battle. If this sounds like it takes away from the experience for you then don't use them, although I guarantee you will want to as they feel just the right amount of Over Powered while still not breaking the game. I could go on for hours about the open world that rewards you for exploring every nook and cranny or the insanely in depth and addicting story that seems to endlessly branch of into many interesting side narratives. But I am just going to end this review by saying, Yes, buy the game. If it is to expensive for you at the moment then get it on CD-keys or even wait for it to go on sale.  You will not regret it.

You reach a point early on when you can let the game run in the background most of the time and make progress by checking in every 1-2 hours or so. You even make progress while being offline, it just goes a lot slower. It is free.   While there are a lot of offers for in-game purchases, you can make progress without buying anything (should that bother you).  While this is a clicking/idle game, for those who want to, there are little stories you can read. The characters are from all kind of different games and novels, and when you played the Infinity games you may meet some old friends. Admittedly, the latest characters the devs added are their own player characters, but Jarlaxle, Minsc and some others are still there.  Not much to loose here. In the worst case, you simply get bored or loose interest after awhile.

If you force disable v-sync in your driver, the cursed Randy version doesn't seem too bad. The coloured lighting is actually a really nice addition and the new episode is pretty solid and has a similar feel of complexity to the maps found in newer build engine games like Ion Fury.  But as you keep playing, more issues start to present themselves. V-sync is not able to be turned off from within the game, and it adds significant input delay so must be disabled in your GPU driver. For some reason activating keycard locks and switches will just stop working for extended periods of time, no matter how much you mash the use key, they just won't respond and then they just start working again after a bit for reasons unknown. Noticeable hitching will be experienced when new sounds play, a significant pause that can be very frustrating if you're dealing with a difficult fight. There's probably other weird smaller issues I haven't noticed yet either.  These problems stack up and just become more and more irritating as you play. Coupled with the dirty feeling you get giving any money to Gearbox I can't recommend this.  If you insist on playing this version you can mitigate these issues by, as mentioned, turning off v-sync in your GPU driver, then limit the FPS to 60, set power management to prefer maximum performance (nvidia specific) and use Reshade to down sample the resolution for chunky pixels (optional). To deal with the suttering I've found running a scan on the games folder with windows defender or similar anti-malware is enough to get windows to cache enough file information to eliminate the pauses. If you have the game installed on an SSD you hopefully won't need to do this. You can also use the Special K wrapper tool to force v-sync modes, borderless window etc, I've found this works even better than the aforementioned driver tweaks but either way will work. Doing all these things should ensure your time with the game is as optimal as possible.  There's a myriad of ways to play and obtain the older releases, so if you don't want to fund any more of Randy's greasy adventures no one will blame you. Grab it on deep discount. You can also play the new episode in BuildGDX or Eduke, which both support it now.  I got it for 2 bucks which is about the maximum I would pay, having bought many versions of the game previously.

Sons of the Forest ist, wie sein Vorgänger schon, ein hervorragendes und atmosphärisches Survival Spiel.  Die Entwickler haben die genial Formel von The Forest optimiert und verbessert.  Grafisch wird hier ein sehr hoher Maßstab gesetzt. Das Spiel sieht verdammt gut aus und  ist Atmosphärisch der Hammer.  Das Gameplay macht Spaß, die Kampfmechanik ist Klasse und die Feinde verhalten sich sehr gut und überzeugend.  Gut Kelvin haut schon gern mal ein Baumhaus klein. Man sollte ihn keine Stämme holen lassen wenn man ein Baumhaus bauen will. Teilweise verstecken sich Feinde in Laubhaufen und Büschen und springen vor einem heraus.  Die gesamt Insel ist riesig und abwechslungsreich gestaltet. In den Höhlen ist es wie im Vorgänger erstklassig Atmosphärisch und gruselig. Es gibt jede menge zu erkunden und zu entdecken.  Die Entwickler Endnight Game haben ganze Arbeit geleistet und mal wieder hervorragend abgeliefert.  Großes Lob und vielen Dank für dieses Klasse Spiel!!!  Wer The Forest schon mochte kommt hier nicht dran vorbei.  Sons of the Forest ist ein hervorragender Nachfolger. Klare Kaufempfehlung!!!

I really really want to give this game a positive but there are just somethings that hold it back for me. I also want to start out saying I am not really good at reviewing and writing stuff. I myself am no dark souls master fan but I have played a good chunk of dark souls 1 and 3 and a little bit of 2 though I have beaten bloodborne and played through multiple times. The game does have many positives like the art style and graphics being very beautiful. This game has one of the best exploration I have ever seen in the game, the most fun I have had in the game was riding around on torrent and finding stuff to do. But the game has many negatives. One big thing that bothered me was how the player character felt the same as dark souls while the enemies were from bloodborne. Its really weird how fromsoft decided after bloodborne and sekiro they would revert back to how the character played like in the older games. Enemies can also input read as well, so as soon as you press the button to heal or something else enemies will immediately hit you. It would be fine if drinking the flasks didnt have such a long animation lock, it would be an easy fix to have it be like in bloodborne where blood vials were quick to use. Two things about about enemies in the game bother me, one is the fact that a lot of major bosses are reused in random places, for example you could find Astel again in some random bum fuck mine in the snow area which brings me to my second issue. The final snow area in the game in my opinion has a bunch of mobs that dont really belong there. The game also has many bugs from stuttering and arcane scaling being broken. The last big issue for me is how some if not most quests straight up are unfinished. If all of this would somehow be fixed I would happily replay the game but for right now I just kind of feel disappointed. Also I would love if people could correct me on things I messed up or missed. 可以一试的类密特罗德小品。  游戏性上，战斗以弹反和金身冲刺为主，地图解密以跑酷为主。总结起来…其实挺平庸的，而且没什么逃课的玩法，所以又是个以背板为主题的游戏。好在boss战的设计足够精彩，能给玩家以足够的正反馈。  但是游戏性上的缺点很明显，简单说几点。 武器看起来很多，其实能用的没几把。 护甲纸糊的，提供不了有效防御，主要作用是提供套装技能。 几乎没有的地图hint，找路全靠信仰之跃。 重复度高且恼人的杂鱼战与精英怪。  再说说游戏性以外的。美术风格和音乐风格塑造的独特游戏氛围很吸引人，但是叙事方式又是谜语，甚至游戏内容都在为这个直到最后也没讲清楚的故事服务[spoiler]比如很多评论都在抱怨的神经通道，这玩意作为传送点几乎没用，个人觉得只是在暗示游戏舞台是发生在某个“生物”的体内而已[/spoiler]，而且虽然我很认真地做了剧情的考察，考察到最后也只能承认我把这个故事想得太复杂了脚本只是用一大堆故弄玄虚的名词和故弄玄虚的图鉴讲了一个不能再烂大街的故事。  综上，我个人其实是没法给出瑕不掩瑜的评价的，5/10吧，可惜steam并不能给中评。总感觉这几年所谓“类魂”的横版游戏特别多，这种以弹反作为核心的战斗模式，以猜谜作为中心的叙事模式的游戏，别说是类密特罗德，甚至都不怎么类ARPG恶魔城了，可能现在的脚本和玩家都觉得不把话说清楚很酷吧。
